_comment: Project fidelity config for SPX home tx-rows master 619:8235. Same tolerances/gate as the toast/dialog masters. textContainerStyle off — TxRow surface (bg/border/radius) is anchored from the row container, not the label text, and each label sits inside its own mid/pill frame. fontAliases match the HarmonyOS Sans TC ↔ bundled Plus Jakarta Sans (Latin) contract used across cards/auth/toast/dialog.
_fontAliasNote: Figma master labels the CJK family 'HarmonyOS Sans TC'; impl uses the bundled PlusJakartaSans-* (Latin) — same family alias contract as cards/auth/buttons.

deviations.reason: SVG <path>/<circle> stroke is verified path-by-path by icon-diff (0 fail / 11 icons). extract-impl reads getComputedStyle(<path>).borderTopColor → CSS default #e5e7eb, NOT the SVG stroke attribute. Color fidelity of every Vector here is already proven by the icon-diff path-set match against the Figma SVG export; this deviation only suppresses the false-positive that the token-diff would otherwise raise on every icon path.

Same tool limitation as borderColor — SVG strokeWidth is not surfaced as CSS borderWidth by getComputedStyle. Already validated via icon-diff (stroke widths come from the Figma SVG verbatim through svg-to-component.mjs).

Same SVG-fill tool limitation — the danger-circle inner dot (I619:8247;586:7400) renders <circle fill='#F52F32'/> in impl; getComputedStyle returns transparent because there's no CSS background-color on an SVG <circle>. Fill is verified path-by-path by icon-diff.

Plus Jakarta Sans Medium renders '+120.00 USD' ~76px wide vs HarmonyOS Sans TC's 73px in the Figma reference (3-4px font-metric drift baked into the bundled-Latin substitution). Text is right-aligned to the row's right edge in both designs, so the right edge matches — only the left edge (box.x) shifts by the width delta. Same fontAliases reconciliation pattern used by cards/auth/toast/dialog masters.
Same font-metric drift as +120.00 USD — Plus Jakarta Sans Medium is wider than HarmonyOS Sans TC, shifting the right-aligned amount's left edge ~3-4px.

Date Text drops the explicit width:101 from the figma master so the string cannot wrap (visual bug caught in wave-4 user review — PlusJakartaSans-Regular renders '2026-05-15 19:13' wider than HarmonyOS Sans TC; with width:101 the second line clipped below the 33px mid container). Single-line is enforced via numberOfLines={1}; intrinsic width measures ~108px vs figma 101 (~7px drift, same family as the amount.x deviations). Overflow lands in the row's right-side flex spacer, never overlapping the amount column.

_textMatchNote: Master frame is 350px wide with rows stacked vertically gap=12. Same-text date strings repeat across rows but matched by y-position; 80px max-center-dist is safe.
